project_type: Next.js 14 + React 18 + Tailwind CSS 3 web application with glassmorphism aesthetic
build_system: Next.js with npm. Uses SWC for minification and webpack with custom config for face-api.js browser compatibility
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run build' to verify TypeScript compilation and Next.js build succeeds. Check responsive layouts by testing at various viewport widths: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop)
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - all source files are hand-authored
environment_constraints: Windows environment. Webpack configured with fallbacks for face-api.js (fs, path, crypto set to false for browser). Firebase and canvas-confetti dependencies present
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing glassmorphism aesthetic (backdrop-blur, bg-opacity, border-opacity classes). Do not modify business logic, API routes, or data-fetching. Maintain all Framer Motion animations. All interactive elements must meet 44x44px minimum touch target on mobile
key_patterns: Mobile-first Tailwind approach: base styles = mobile, then sm: (640px), md: (768px), lg: (1024px), xl: (1280px) breakpoints. Layout uses flex/grid extensively. Components use 'text-xs', 'text-sm' for smaller screens. Drawers and modals are full-width on mobile. Character components (RiggedAnimeCharacter, LiveCharacter) use fixed pixel dimensions that need responsive scaling
directory_structure: src/app/ contains page routes (page.tsx files). src/components/ organized by feature (layout/, auth/, character/, documents/, employees/, ui/). src/lib/ contains utilities, AI engines, mock data, and Firebase auth context
